component.name: JeremiahAI
component.summary: Personal AI continuity, writing, and project orchestration

description.p: JeremiahAI is a desktop application for personal AI-assisted project continuity, writing workflows, task orchestration, family data tools, troubleshooting, and recovery-oriented workflows.

It provides a central interface for managing writing projects, reviewing writing feedback, coordinating local AI workflows, maintaining project context, and working with lightweight recovery services.
